products.title: Pins And Dominant Position Escape Engineering by Adam Wardziński
products.body:
Turn the Tide from the Bottom — Learn Elite-Level Escape Systems from One of the Most Battle-Tested Gi Competitors in the World

  • Adam Wardziński is no stranger to pressure — both delivering it and escaping it. As one of the most decorated gi athletes of his generation, Adam has achieved the Super Grand Slam, winning every major IBJJF title in dominant fashion.
  • Now, for the first time, he's sharing the exact escape systems that helped him survive and reverse the toughest positions in high-stakes competition.
  • In Pins and Dominant Position Escape Engineering, Adam breaks down his battle-tested escapes from side control, mount, back control, knee-on-belly, and more — all with the clarity, detail, and realism you'd expect from someone who’s done it at the highest level.
  • These aren’t hypothetical movements. These are the real-world escape blueprints he’s used under the lights, against the best.


Check Out a Free Sample:

What will You Learn?

Turn the Tide from the Bottom — Learn Elite-Level Escape Systems from One of the Most Battle-Tested Gi Competitors in the World

Adam Wardziński is no stranger to pressure — both delivering it and escaping it. As one of the most decorated gi athletes of his generation, Adam has achieved the Super Grand Slam, winning every major IBJJF title in dominant fashion. Now, for the first time, he's sharing the exact escape systems that helped him survive and reverse the toughest positions in high-stakes competition.

In Pins and Dominant Position Escape Engineering, Adam breaks down his battle-tested escapes from side control, mount, back control, knee-on-belly, and more — all with the clarity, detail, and realism you'd expect from someone who’s done it at the highest level. These aren’t hypothetical movements. These are the real-world escape blueprints he’s used under the lights, against the best.

Whether you're a hobbyist struggling to stay safe under pressure or a serious competitor looking to build unshakable defense, this series will redefine how you think about escaping — and countering — dominant positions.

💥 Key Features:

  • 🛡️ Elite Escape Systems – Learn the exact movements Adam uses to escape side control, mount, back control, and more — proven at the world’s highest levels.

  • 🔄 Momentum-Shifting Counters – Don’t just escape — reverse, attack, and turn the tide in your favor immediately.

  • 🧠 Principle-Based Approach – Go beyond techniques with Adam’s deep insights into timing, structure, and how to dismantle your opponent’s control.

  • ⚔️ Battle-Tested Under Pressure – Every escape shown has been used in live competition at the international level.

  • 🎓 Designed for All Levels – Whether you’re new to BJJ or a seasoned brown or black belt, Adam’s teaching is clear, detailed, and highly adaptable.

  • 👊 Gi-Specific Details – Learn how to leverage grips, lapels, and sleeve control to your advantage in defensive situations.

products.title: Pinning and Pressure Engineering by Adam Wardzinski
products.body:
In Pinning and Pressure Engineering, BJJ World Champion Adam Wardziński shares the battle-tested pressure passing system that has suffocated elite guard players around the globe.

  • Known for his relentless top game and calculated control, Adam reveals how to dictate the pace, dismantle active guards, and impose pressure that forces mistakes and opens submissions.
  • Whether you're facing dynamic open guard players or stubborn half guard experts, this series will give you the tools to neutralize their movement and dominate the match on your terms

  • Adam’s method is built on fundamentals, sharpened through championship experience, and proven effective at the highest levels of competition.

  • If you've ever struggled to slow down guard players or find your rhythm on top, this is the blueprint you’ve been waiting for.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Take the fight out of your opponents and the wind out of their game.

In Pinning and Pressure Engineering, BJJ World Champion Adam Wardziński shares the battle-tested pressure passing system that has suffocated elite guard players around the globe. Known for his relentless top game and calculated control, Adam reveals how to dictate the pace, dismantle active guards, and impose pressure that forces mistakes and opens submissions.

Whether you're facing dynamic open guard players or stubborn half guard experts, this series will give you the tools to neutralize their movement and dominate the match on your terms. Adam’s method is built on fundamentals, sharpened through championship experience, and proven effective at the highest levels of competition.

If you've ever struggled to slow down guard players or find your rhythm on top, this is the blueprint you’ve been waiting for.

What You'll Learn:

  • 💥 Pressure-Based Passing Concepts – How to slow down fast-paced guard players and force them into your game

  • 🧱 Foundation of Control – Learn the mechanics behind creating crushing top pressure that limits movement and forces reactions

  • 🚧 Guard Breaking Strategies – Systematic approaches to dismantling common open and closed guard positions

  • 🔒 Pinning Positions that Stick – How to establish and maintain pinning control that wears down even elite opponents

  • ⏳ Pace Control Tactics – Take control of the tempo and drain your opponent’s energy round by round

  • 🛠️ Battle-Tested Techniques – The exact passing sequences Adam has used to win world, European, and Brazilian titles

  • 🎯 Situational Drills & Concepts – Build instinct and flow by training with intention and purpose

Why Learn from Adam Wardziński?

Adam is one of the most decorated grapplers on the planet, with titles including:
🏆 IBJJF World Champion
🇪🇺 European Champion
🇧🇷 Brazilian National Champion

His pressure-based style isn’t flashy—it’s ferocious, fundamental, and built to last. With this instructional, you’ll gain insight into the mindset and mechanics of a world-class top game, and learn how to make your passing game feel inevitable.

products.title: Engineering Bundle by Adam Wardzinski
products.body:
The complete Engineering series by Adam Wardzinski in one bundle: 6 courses, 27 volumes.

  • All 6 courses of the Engineering series, each one complete with every volume
  • The same method applied position by position, so each course builds on the others

What Will You Learn?

Adam Wardzinski built the Engineering series one course at a time, each one focused on a single part of the game. This bundle puts all 6 together so you can study the series as one connected system.

Inside you will find: Knee Lever John Wayne Sweep Engineering, Octopus Guard Engineering, Foot Sweeps, Ankle Picks and Tripods Engineering, Pinning and Pressure Engineering, Pins And Dominant Position Escape Engineering and Clamp Guard Engineering.

  • Knee Lever John Wayne Sweep Engineering by Adam Wardzinski
  • Octopus Guard Engineering by Adam Wardzinski
  • Foot Sweeps, Ankle Picks and Tripods Engineering by Adam Wardzinski

  • Pins And Dominant Position Escape Engineering by Adam Wardziński
  • Clamp Guard Engineering by Adam Wardzinski

products.title: The Pillars of Defense: Pin Escapes - Defensive to Offensive Cycles by Gordon Ryan
products.body:
Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!!

  • Get all the highest percentage ways to get out of the mount, side control, knee on belly, north-south, and more in this new nine-part series!
  • Gordon “The King” Ryan is a multiple-time ADCC champion who is the most dominant and technical no-gi grappler on Earth, and this is your chance to learn his pin escaping!
  • See how to turn your defensive cycles into offensive cycles as fast as possible, as Gordon explains how to turn their pins into your counter-attacking opportunities
  • Learn details to make your kipping escapes, side guards, tricep post escapes, and more work against opposition of all levels
  • Gordon’s escaping skill is the basis of his game on the mat - never spending time held down in bad positions gives him the confidence to attack relentlessly
  • See actual rolling footage from the gym as Gordon puts this system into action and then breaks down exactly what he was doing so you can see the techniques in motion


Escape From Every Dominant Pin In Grappling With These Systems & Strategies From The Best No-Gi Grappler On Earth, Gordon “The King” Ryan, As He Shows You His Methods For Turning Defensive Cycles Into Offensive Cycles As Fast As Possible

Check Out Sample!


What Will You Learn?

Don’t spend time stuck and held down in pinning positions anymore - instead build a game with the real technical skill to escape from anywhere with Gordon “The King” Ryan’s new 9-part series on how to get out of all the major pinning positions of grappling. With his help, including live rolling footage with breakdowns, you’ll see how the best grappler on Earth gets out of mount, side control, north south, and more.

Use all the most modern and high-percentage methods to escape, with detailed breakdowns in how each system works from Gordon. Use kipping escapes, elbow escapes, underhooks, and much more as he brings you through how each position is unique and how he has made a career out of never being able to be pinned.

With Gordon’s advice, see how to turn these bad positions into offensive opportunities as fast as possible with his strategies on defensive to offensive cycling. Attack on the escape with leg lock entries, clamp guard, wrestling attacks, and more as he shows how each escape flows seamlessly into an offensive position that you can take advantage of.

Watch these systems in action as Gordon rolls live in the gym and then breaks down each roll - for you to see what he’s doing and hear why he’s doing it. With 9 volumes full of material for you to study, this offers you a full encyclopedia of all the major pins and their variations that you’ll need to escape from, with full explanations from Gordon Ryan on how you should be building your game from any of them.
